rationale: Whole-genome Brie knockout depletion screen in BA/F3-MPL cells (one GEO sample, GSM6172301, holding a PoolQ count table with 8 conditions). The paper's main comparison (Figure 1C-D, supplemental Table 1 sheet DEL-_vs_EV+) is CALR del52 cells grown without IL3 (MPL-dependent, CALR-driven growth) against empty-vector cells grown with IL3, both at day 21, two independent biological replicate lines (A, B) each. Genes needed specifically for CALR-mutant transformation are depleted in DEL-IL3. A and B are independent cell lines per genotype, so they are not paired across arms and no replicate term is used. The deposit has no plasmid or early time point; DELA+ was harvested at day 11 instead of 21, so the DEL- vs DEL+ comparison is not reproduced here. Gene labels come from the deposited Brie annotation (prepare.R); controls are the 1000 Brie non-targeting guides.
